title: 第1章 死后灵魂移民获得第二条命很合理吧-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    秦夙睁开眼，人已经不在地球了。

    她拥有了一副全新的身体。

    已经照过镜子了。

    年轻，貌美，很温柔无害的一张脸，还拥有很特别的暗红发色和眸色，她只看了一眼就爱上的程度。

    跟偷摸穿越无人知的剧情不同。

    负责给她做身体检查的医生说，她的“魂穿”，属于一种战略资源回收再利用的特殊手段。

    和医生道别后，秦夙带上体检资料，在这座高塔般的建筑里找了好久。

    塔里到处都白白的，走到哪都是一个样，太容易迷路了。

    好不容易找到能通往档案中心的电梯。

    叮的一声，门打开。

    秦夙突然感觉到一股强大的威压！

    电梯里站着个身高超过两米的，穿黑色军礼服的男人。

    随着男人抬眸盯上她。

    秦夙只觉得，气氛变得如同暴风雨即将到来一般。

    脑补出大片的乌云，突然笼罩在她头顶上的画面，连空气都变得沉闷起来。

    她赶紧往旁边让开，“不好意思。”

    男人皱了皱眉。

    毫不遮掩眼中正在对她进行的审视，让秦夙觉得他对她好像莫名的心怀着某种不满。

    “要去档案中心？”他问。

    好一个冷酷无情的低音炮，但他怎么知道？

    秦夙对这种扑面而来的压迫感还是有点畏惧，“是……是的。”

    “我带你去，进来。”

    “……好。”但是为什么？

    她小心的站在电梯远离男人的角落，“谢谢……”

    电梯上行的过程中，秦夙一抬眼就看到男人高大的背影，宽阔的后背，劲瘦的腰身。

    笔挺的军装难以掩盖包裹在内鼓鼓囊囊的肌肉。

    医生说过，白塔里能看到的黑军装，都是哨兵。

    肩章上花样越复杂的，代表军阶越高，作战能力也越强。

    可是没有对比，秦夙不知道这男人肩章算不算复杂。

    以她目前168的身高，也没法看清整个肩章上的图案。

    她就，踮脚，伸脖子。

    “我叫离颂，S级哨兵。”男人突然开口，“和你匹配度尚可，以后你就是我的随队向导了，直接叫我的名字，记不住名字，叫长官或队长也可以。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Qin Su opened his eyes, he was no longer on the earth.

She has a new body.

I’ve already looked in the mirror.

​Young, beautiful, with a very gentle and harmless face, and with a very special dark red hair color and eye color, she fell in love with him after just one look.

It is different from the plot of sneaking through time and space that no one knows about.

The doctor responsible for her physical examination said that her "soul penetration" was a special method of strategic resource recycling.

After saying goodbye to the doctor, Qin Su took the physical examination information and searched for it in this tower-like building for a long time.

Everywhere in the tower is white, and it looks the same wherever you go, so it’s easy to get lost.

It was difficult to find the elevator leading to the archives center.

With a ding, the door opened.

Qin Su suddenly felt a strong pressure!

Standing in the elevator was a man over two meters tall and wearing a black military uniform.

As the man raised his eyes and stared at her.

Qin Su only felt that the atmosphere became as if a storm was coming.

The image of large dark clouds suddenly covering her head made the air feel dull.

She quickly stepped aside, "I'm sorry."

The man frowned.

The unabashed scrutiny of her in his eyes made Qin Su feel that he had some inexplicable dissatisfaction with her.

“Going to the archives center?” he asked.

What a ruthless subwoofer, but how does he know?

Qin Su was still a little afraid of this sense of oppression, "Yes... yes."

"I'll take you there, come in."

"...Okay." But why?

She carefully stood in the corner of the elevator away from the man, "Thank you..."

As the elevator went up, Qin Su looked up and saw the man's tall figure, broad back, and thin waist.

The straight military uniform can hardly hide the bulging muscles wrapped inside.

The doctor said that the black military uniforms that can be seen in the White Tower are sentries.

The more complicated the pattern on the epaulettes, the higher the military rank and the stronger the combat capability.

But without comparison, Qin Su didn’t know if this man’s epaulettes were complicated.

With her current height of 168cm, she cannot clearly see the entire pattern on the epaulettes.

She just stood on tiptoes and stretched her neck.

"My name is Li Song, an S-class sentinel." The man suddenly said, "I am a good match for you. From now on, you will be my team guide. Just call me by my name. If you can't remember the name, you can also call me sir or captain."

title_en: Chapter 1 Is it reasonable for the soul to immigrate after death and gain a second life - "What to do if you are targeted by N S-class sentries at the same time"
